visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and a wide black headband stands in a well-lit indoor living space. She is wearing a sleeveless brown turtleneck top and a silver necklace with a star pendant. She looks directly at the camera, talking and gesturing with her hands. The background shows a white wall with a framed picture and a dark dining table and chairs in the distance. (2) She holds up two transparent glass perfume bottles with black caps and white labels toward the camera. The camera zooms in on one bottle labeled "201 EAU DE PARFUM FIR & AMBER". She gestures toward the bottles while talking, her facial expressions are animated and her eyes are wide with excitement. (3) She holds one bottle, removes the cap, and sprays it near her wrist and neck. She brings her wrist to her nose to smell the scent, closing her eyes briefly with a look of appreciation. She repeats this with the second bottle, which has a yellowish liquid. Digital overlays with pricing and promotional text appear at the bottom as she continues to talk and showcase the items.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 告訴你. (2) [Subtitle]: 2000元內質感香水. (3) [Subtitle]: 來就是這兩支 Ran的香水. (4) [Subtitle]: 第一支是我自己非常喜歡的味道冷杉琥珀. [Variety]: (我應該講了有100萬次說我多愛它). (5) [Subtitle]: 如果你喜歡木質調 你跟人的距離感 適中偏有點遠一點點的話 我覺得你會很喜歡. (6) [Subtitle]: 它是一股非常清冷的味道 一般香水木質調琥珀 其實非常常見 可是它加入了冷杉 就是那個 一點點高冷的感覺. (7) [Subtitle]: 太喜歡😍. (8) [Subtitle]: 大大小小品牌的香水 我真的沒有找到 跟冷杉琥珀是雷同的味道 這一支 超級讚. (9) [Subtitle]: 再來這一支 薰衣草岩蘭草 我從來沒有想過 我會喜歡這個味道. (10) [Subtitle]: 因為我普遍對薰衣草的味道 太甜膩不喜歡. (11) [Subtitle]: 但是這一支呢 它因為最後加入了那個岩蘭草 它有一股 比較溼潤感的木質調 (有點像潮濕泥土快乾的味道). (12) [Subtitle]: 薰衣草的個性 整個人就立體起來 變得比較有一點點 強硬的薰衣草. (13) [Subtitle]: 我蠻喜歡聞到最後 它會有一點點 酸跟木質調揉合的味道 可是酸走的非常非常的和緩. (14) [Subtitle]: Ran的香水的持香度 在我身上的話 大概是4-5小時左右. (15) [Subtitle]: 它全部的香材 都是歐洲進口 然後價格 2000元內有找 然後非常榮幸 是這次跟他獨家合作. (16) [Subtitle]: 所以他大家的香水 在我這邊可以優先先買到. [Slogan]: 獨家優惠 1680 (優惠價格到10/19). (17) [Subtitle]: 最後就是滿2500元 還再送隨身香水. [Slogan]: 可以優先先買到 (拍賣官網獨家首賣). [Slogan]: 還再送隨身香水 隨身香水 冷杉琥珀 11ml.
